solution_steps.note: All nine OBX segments validate, so the whole message files to ACC-EX01-0001 (inbound_hl7.ingest_message: all-or-nothing filing).
Specimen ACCESSIONED, all nine required probes present, every result below its cutoff and called NORMAL: validation has no ERROR findings, so workflow.finalize_order creates the FINALIZED report.
Store one OUTBOUND HL7 ORU-style message; generated-at fixes MSH-7 and the control id (outbound_hl7.store_oru).
Store one OUTBOUND FHIR-style DiagnosticReport Bundle (outbound_fhir.store_diagnostic_report).

question_answers.answer: Finalization calls workflow.run_validation, which runs validation.validate_order: SPEC_ACCESSIONED, MISSING_PROBE, CELL_COUNT_LOW, ABN_EXCEEDS_SCORED and INTERP_CONSISTENCY. This order produces no findings: the specimen is ACCESSIONED, all nine required probes have results, every probe has 200 cells scored (minimum 100), and every percent abnormal is below its synthetic cutoff with a NORMAL call. The VALIDATION_RUN audit detail is 'findings=0 errors=0' and no validation_error rows are stored.

It was refused. interfaces.collect_report_data raises OutboundError for an order whose status is not FINALIZED, so no HL7-style or FHIR-style message can be built or stored; the analyst CLI reports OutboundError as REFUSED (exit 4).

Inbound OBX-5 packs cells_scored^cells_abnormal^signal_pattern^interpretation (OBX-3 component 1 is the probe code). Filing writes fish_result.cells_scored, cells_abnormal, signal_pattern and interpretation. The stored HL7-style OBX-5 reads 'abnormal/scored nuclei (percent%) INTERPRETATION; signal pattern' with the A/N/I flag in OBX-8 and the cutoff in OBX-7, after two leading REPORT and IMPRESSION OBX segments. The FHIR-style Observation carries percent abnormal in valueQuantity, the interpretation in interpretation[0].text (code N/A/I), and the counts and pattern in note[0].text. Example CEP8: inbound '200^3^2 aqua^NORMAL' -> fish_result 200/3 NORMAL -> HL7 '3/200 nuclei (1.5%) NORMAL; signal 2 aqua' -> FHIR valueQuantity 1.5 and note '3/200 nuclei scored; signal pattern 2 aqua'.

The lab_order audit event INBOUND_RESULT_FILED, whose free-text detail is 'message_id=1 probes=9 (...)'. It is not a foreign key: fish_result has no column that references interface_message, and interface_message.order_id links the message to the order, not to individual results. Which message produced a current result value is therefore not recorded by the schema.
